en.text: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”

zhSimplified.text: 我听见有大声音从殿中出来，向那七位天使说：「你们去，把盛 神大怒的七碗倒在地上。」

zhTraditional.text: 我聽見有大聲音從殿中出來，向那七位天使說：「你們去，把盛上帝大怒的七碗倒在地上。」

en.text: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

zhSimplified.text: 第一位天使便去，把碗倒在地上，就有恶而且毒的疮生在那些有兽印记、拜兽像的人身上。

zhTraditional.text: 第一位天使便去，把碗倒在地上，就有惡而且毒的瘡生在那些有獸印記、拜獸像的人身上。

en.text: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.

zhSimplified.text: 第二位天使把碗倒在海里，海就变成血，好像死人的血，海中的活物都死了。

zhTraditional.text: 第二位天使把碗倒在海裏，海就變成血，好像死人的血，海中的活物都死了。

en.text: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

zhSimplified.text: 第三位天使把碗倒在江河与众水的泉源里，水就变成血了。

zhTraditional.text: 第三位天使把碗倒在江河與眾水的泉源裏，水就變成血了。

en.text: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.

zhSimplified.text: 我听见掌管众水的天使说： 昔在、今在的圣者啊， 你这样判断是公义的；

zhTraditional.text: 我聽見掌管眾水的天使說： 昔在、今在的聖者啊， 你這樣判斷是公義的；

en.text: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们曾流圣徒与先知的血， 现在你给他们血喝； 这是他们所该受的。

zhTraditional.text: 他們曾流聖徒與先知的血， 現在你給他們血喝； 這是他們所該受的。

en.text: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”

zhSimplified.text: 我又听见祭坛中有声音说： 是的，主 神—全能者啊， 你的判断义哉！诚哉！

zhTraditional.text: 我又聽見祭壇中有聲音說： 是的，主上帝－全能者啊， 你的判斷義哉！誠哉！

en.text: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.

zhSimplified.text: 第四位天使把碗倒在日头上，叫日头能用火烤人。

zhTraditional.text: 第四位天使把碗倒在日頭上，叫日頭能用火烤人。

en.text: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.

zhSimplified.text: 人被大热所烤，就亵渎那有权掌管这些灾的 神之名，并不悔改将荣耀归给 神。

zhTraditional.text: 人被大熱所烤，就褻瀆那有權掌管這些災的上帝之名，並不悔改將榮耀歸給上帝。

en.text: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,

zhSimplified.text: 第五位天使把碗倒在兽的座位上，兽的国就黑暗了。人因疼痛就咬自己的舌头；

zhTraditional.text: 第五位天使把碗倒在獸的座位上，獸的國就黑暗了。人因疼痛就咬自己的舌頭；

en.text: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They still didn’t repent of their works.

zhSimplified.text: 又因所受的疼痛，和生的疮，就亵渎天上的 神，并不悔改所行的。

zhTraditional.text: 又因所受的疼痛，和生的瘡，就褻瀆天上的上帝，並不悔改所行的。

en.text: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.

zhSimplified.text: 第六位天使把碗倒在幼发拉底大河上，河水就干了，要给那从日出之地所来的众王预备道路。

zhTraditional.text: 第六位天使把碗倒在幼發拉底大河上，河水就乾了，要給那從日出之地所來的眾王預備道路。

en.text: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;

zhSimplified.text: 我又看见三个污秽的灵，好像青蛙，从龙口、兽口并假先知的口中出来。

zhTraditional.text: 我又看見三個污穢的靈，好像青蛙，從龍口、獸口並假先知的口中出來。

en.text: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God the Almighty.

zhSimplified.text: 他们本是鬼魔的灵，施行奇事，出去到普天下众王那里，叫他们在 神全能者的大日聚集争战。

zhTraditional.text: 他們本是鬼魔的靈，施行奇事，出去到普天下眾王那裏，叫他們在上帝全能者的大日聚集爭戰。（

en.text: “Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn’ t walk naked, and they see his shame.”

zhSimplified.text: 看哪，我来像贼一样。那警醒、看守衣服、免得赤身而行、叫人见他羞耻的有福了！

zhTraditional.text: 看哪，我來像賊一樣。那警醒、看守衣服、免得赤身而行、叫人見他羞恥的有福了！）

en.text: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.

zhSimplified.text: 那三个鬼魔便叫众王聚集在一处，希伯来话叫作哈米吉多顿。

zhTraditional.text: 那三個鬼魔便叫眾王聚集在一處，希伯來話叫作哈米吉多頓。

en.text: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

zhSimplified.text: 第七位天使把碗倒在空中，就有大声音从殿中的宝座上出来，说：「成了！」

zhTraditional.text: 第七位天使把碗倒在空中，就有大聲音從殿中的寶座上出來，說：「成了！」

en.text: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.

zhSimplified.text: 又有闪电、声音、雷轰、大地震，自从地上有人以来，没有这样大、这样厉害的地震。

zhTraditional.text: 又有閃電、聲音、雷轟、大地震，自從地上有人以來，沒有這樣大、這樣厲害的地震。

en.text: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

zhSimplified.text: 那大城裂为三段，列国的城也都倒塌了； 神也想起巴比伦大城来，要把那盛自己烈怒的酒杯递给他。

zhTraditional.text: 那大城裂為三段，列國的城也都倒塌了；上帝也想起巴比倫大城來，要把那盛自己烈怒的酒杯遞給他。

en.text: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

zhSimplified.text: 各海岛都逃避了，众山也不见了。

zhTraditional.text: 各海島都逃避了，眾山也不見了。

en.text: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague was exceedingly severe.

footnotes.text: 16:21 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds.

zhSimplified.text: 又有大雹子从天落在人身上，每一个约重一他连得。为这雹子的灾极大，人就亵渎 神。

zhTraditional.text: 又有大雹子從天落在人身上，每一個約重一他連得。為這雹子的災極大，人就褻瀆上帝。
